Page PAGE PDF Vectorisation Pipeline Language Python or Node.js Vector DB Your choice OVERVIEW Build a pipeline with two components: (1) an ingestion script that extracts text from a PDF, chunks it, generates vector embeddings, and stores them in a vector database; and (2) a retrieval endpoint that accepts a plain-text query and returns the most semantically similar chunks from the stored embeddings.
